title: Say Trono ya linma ed sakey a bekta
intro: Sakey a too ya walaan na baleg ya autoridad so nanuley ed sakey a mayaman a panarian ya abendisyonan na agnasukat a kayamanan. Sanen linmesa so ag-iilaloan a angat, sayan manuley so nipaarap ed subok ya aliwan panamegley na saray kampilan noagta lapud kakabatan tan pananisia. Say agawa et mangitonton manlapud sankatageyan a pakayari na mundo ya anggad baleg a pananguman na puso.
clues: Inuleyan ko so sakey a panarian ya abendisyonan na kayamanan tan inkaaligwas ya agnaisip
Sakey ak a makapanyarin monarka ya akaawat na maksil a sulat a mankekerew na panagpasakop
Sinimbawa ak na saray gagalangen ko no kasin milaban ak odino mikareenan ed sayan arawin ari
Linma ak ya walaan na mararakep iran regalo pian abeten ko iyan arawin ari
Say tronkon ari et niyakar ed sakey a pasen ya arawin pasen diad kirem na matak, kasakbayan ak ya makapawil
Nen linmoob ak ed sakey a palasyo ya say datal to et singa salming ya makinis, diad kaunoran et inyabawag ko so panagpasakop ko ed si Allah

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Bilqis, Reyna na Sheba
Say Asawa nen Faraon
Say asawa nen Al-Aziz
Maryam, Anak nen Imran
Say Asawa nen Propeta Lut

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Makaawat na maksil a sulat ya mankaukolan na pangipasakop
Say pangibantak ed mandarlang ya apoy
Say inakmon na baleg a sira
Pigaran taon na ansakisakit ya sakit
Naimatonan so inkaderal na sakey a totoo lapud delap
trial.answer: Makaawat na maksil a sulat ya mankaukolan na pangipasakop

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a makapadinayew a trono na ari a balitok tan ankablin
Sakey a baston ya angibiig ed dayat
Sakey a biong ya akaalagey ed palandey
Sakey a sagradon abung na panagdayew ed Makkah
Sakey a balitok a kilaw a baka ya dadayewen na totoo
location.answer: Sakey a makapadinayew a trono na ari a balitok tan ankablin

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Say panagpasakop ed si Allah a kaiba so sakey a propeta
Nalelener ed dayat legan ya uusilan so kalaban
Say mamilagron niliktar ed manliob ya apoy
Say inkabantak manlapud hardin na andi-anggaan a liket
Say pangawat na panarian na baleg a pakayari
outcome.answer: Say panagpasakop ed si Allah a kaiba so sakey a propeta

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
